title: Graziano's at The Lifetime Building
address:
229 S Dixie Hwy
Coral Gables, Florida 33133
United States
description:
Graziano's at The Lifetime Building is an Argentine gourmet market, restaurant, deli, and wine bar. The market and deli side features a full-service meat and deli counter, a bakery, Argentine grocery staples, and an extensive wine selection, while the restaurant and grill turns out made-to-order Argentine dishes cooked on-site.

The space is laid out food-hall style, with casual indoor seating and a covered outdoor terrace.
